sentences.en: The pin pierced his finger and it began to bleed.
sentences.zh: 那枚别针刺破了他的手指，开始流血。

sentences.en: There was complete silence. You could hear a pin drop.
sentences.zh: 现场一片寂静。连一根针掉到地上都能听见。

sentences.en: He always keeps his room as neat as a pin.
sentences.zh: 他总是把房间收拾得井井有条，一尘不染。

senses.zh: 针，饰针，大头针，拴，(有别针的)徽章，小东西，(复数)腿，别住
